name: My Pet Vampire
source:
My Pet Vampire is a BL visual novel about love, memory, and danger.

You play as a hot doctor who shares his home with a mischievous, seductive vampire. He teases you, loves you... and seems to know more than he lets on.
As your connection deepens, so does his possessive affection. But the moment you resist him, the carefully kept secrets he’s been safeguarding begin to crack.

What does he mean by “script”?

Will you uncover the truth before it consumes you?

[From [url=https://blushingneon.itch.io/my-pet-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
